name: branding-designer-life-sticker-character-with-sunglasses
title: 'Designer Life' sticker: a chill cartoon girl in sunglasses with papers and a tablet
whatItIs: A sticker of a cartoon girl with a bun, sunglasses and a mint hoodie leaning back with hands behind her head, a stack of papers and a tablet beside her, 'Designer Life' below, over a faded lilac pattern of the sticker pack.
whatItMeans: Relatable and fun; a designer mascot with attitude speaks to creative in-jokes.
techniques: Give a character one strong pose and prop set.
Use a thick white sticker border.
Fade the full pack behind the hero sticker.

vocabulary.definition: A set of illustrated stickers for messaging apps.
A white outline following a sticker's shape.
